artifacts.summary: Implementation plan with 5 phases to close 4 depth-0 KampBypass sorries and verify downstream Kamp chain

memory_candidates.content: When lean4 implementation cycles fail due to analysis-paralysis (agents writing skeletons/helpers instead of closing sorry goals), the root cause is typically decomposition anti-pattern: splitting a sorry into sub-sorries increases the sorry count rather than reducing it. The fix is to mandate direct sorry closure per dispatch with no sub-decomposition allowed, and to sequence work by confidence level (highest-confidence sorry first) to establish the proof pattern before tackling harder cases. Validated proof recipes (tested tactic sequences saved in handoff files) eliminate ambiguity at implementation time.
